title: 20 quart aluminum basket
text: 20 quart aluminum basket. Purchased this for my 24 quart stainless stock pot.  Fits perfectly - it sits down in the pot with about 5" to the top.  My stock pot is tall.  I use the basket for mini stove top boils.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
